notes.title: Change Log 9/11/23
notes.content:
Added Simple Background setting. This removes all the background flair and leaves just a simple solid color.

Fixed an issue with new installations not getting the correct symbol colors by default (several are supposed to be black for addition contrast). Resetting all colors from the color settings menu will reset these for existing installations.

notes.title: Change Log 8/18/23
notes.content:
Added stat tracking for completed games, all based on number of chemicals in the game and whether it was a hidden game, including:
[list]
[*] Total completed games
[*] Average Moves taken
[*] Average Time taken
[*] Top 10 games by time
[*] Top 10 games by moves
[/list]
